performanceBudget.source: Notion → ⚡ WordPress Performance and Core Web Vitals
performanceBudget.caching: WP Rocket (default) · W3 Total Cache (free alt) · host-native. Cache page + browser + object (Redis/Memcached) + CDN.
performanceBudget.images: Compress before upload (Squoosh/TinyPNG); WebP via Imagify/ShortPixel; lazy-load below fold; LCP image gets loading=eager + fetchpriority=high; width/height on every img to prevent CLS.
performanceBudget.javascript: Vanilla ES2020+ first, no jQuery in custom theme code; defer non-critical; IntersectionObserver for section JS; dequeue unused.
performanceBudget.pluginCap: Max 15 active plugins on custom builds, max 25 on Elementor. Audit quarterly. Plugin sprawl is the single biggest cause of slow WP sites.
performanceBudget.thirdParty: Each third-party script costs 50–200ms TBT. Required: GA4, Search Console. Case-by-case: Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Klaviyo, chat. Rejected by default: full-page A/B testing, generic chat.
performanceBudget.database: WP_POST_REVISIONS = 5; clean transients; OPTIMIZE TABLE before launch.
performanceBudget.tooling: Query Monitor + Plugin Performance Profiler (dev); Lighthouse + WebPageTest + real-device mobile (DevTools mobile mode is not enough).

seoQaGate.note: SEO lead runs this before the build can move to client presentation. Any unchecked item fails the gate.
seoQaGate.urlRules: Permalinks /%postname%/, lowercase, hyphen-separated, canonical present, no redirect chains (A→C not A→B→C), custom 404.
seoQaGate.meta: Unique title < 60 chars, unique description < 155 chars, one H1 per page, alt text on meaningful images.
